The one skipped test is inside tests/trace-evidence.test.ts, which self-skips when OTEL_COLLECTOR_BIN is unset; CI downloads a Linux otelcol-contrib binary for this env var, and no Windows-compatible build of that binary was available locally, so that one sub-case was not exercised here (see the separate 'OTEL trace-evidence sub-case' DidNotRun entry below).

gates.name: OTEL trace-evidence sub-case (tests/trace-evidence.test.ts, within npm test)
gates.reason: This test requires OTEL_COLLECTOR_BIN pointing at a real OpenTelemetry Collector binary. build.yml's CI job downloads otelcol-contrib_0.158.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz (a Linux binary) for this purpose. This session runs on Windows and no Windows-compatible collector binary was fetched, so the test self-skipped rather than running for real; the corresponding CI check on the pull request is where this sub-case is actually exercised.
